One chat is one dated stem: session_conversation_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.

The JSONL is the store. One line is one message, newest last. Each line is one object:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| n | 1, 2, 3… in send order |
| role | user or assistant |
| ts | null on a user line. YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM on an assistant line |
| text | the message as sent. An assistant line includes its session-log block |

User text stays as typed. The HTML body is the view. It fetches the sibling JSONL and draws one block per line. A hidden textarea holds the same JSONL, escaped, so opening the HTML as a local file still renders. Served over http, the page shows the fetch.

assistant_project.md still receives the newest-first session-log entry. That file is the codebase log. This JSONL is this chat.
